name: Volkodlak Sharpshooter
desc:
A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
They possess senses keener than those of humans. Whether in their perception of wind speed or their vision under certain conditions, these traits give them unique advantages, allowing them to achieve far greater accuracy than ordinary people when firing bows, crossbows, or cannons from long range.

dropMaterial.name: Mora
dropMaterial.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

dropMaterial.name: Ethereal Glimmershard
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
These shards once coated the creature's body like crystalline scales. Upon falling away, they stripped themselves of all colors, shifting into something akin to the dusty dross of a moth's wings.

dropMaterial.name: Ethereal Crystal
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A shattered fragment of the crystalline scales that once grew upon the fae's body. Though it is now a mere empty shell, one can still sense the echo of the unique power that once dwelt within.

dropMaterial.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

dropMaterial.name: Accreted Fragment
dropMaterial.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has only just begun to attach to an internal organ or bone. As the Volkodlak's power grows, it may eventually cover an entire region of the body, or a whole organ.

dropMaterial.name: Accreted Mass
dropMaterial.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has clung to an internal organ or bone for a long time. Once removed, such accretions are regarded as symbols of power and carefully preserved by the creature's descendants.

dropMaterial.name: Accreted Growth
dropMaterial.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has fully fused with an organ or bone. One could even say it's a newly grown bone or organ at the nodes of the Volkodlak's power circulation. Only long-lived Volkodlaks who have ceaselessly honed their strength can form such growths within their bodies.

customize.text:
In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills.
Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
